ja: 引っ越しを手伝ってくれてありがとう。本当に困っていたんだ。
en: Thanks for helping me move. I was really struggling.
alternatives: Thank you for helping me move. I was really having a hard time.
Thanks for your help with the move. I was really struggling.
point: 「困っていた」は過去進行形 was struggling で表せる
